answer: Give every agent a reputation island: trust earned in one domain cannot be carried to another, so a Sybil farm must rebuild standing in each island from scratch. Access to paid work requires a layered credential, like an opal built up one thin deposit of verified jobs at a time, each layer signed by independent peers. Misbehavior stains the whole credential umber, a dark permanent mark visible to every verifier, so the attacker loses all accumulated layers at once. Creating a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand separate work histories, while honest agents pay nothing extra.
